programmes.d: In 1991, the bodies of sex workers started being discovered in Detroit, Michigan.
After two couples were brutally murdered three years apart, both cases went cold for almost three decades.
In September 2007, 50-year-old Vietnamese immigrant Cuc Tran was raped and murdered while out on a run.
In 1992, Leslie Allen Williams was arrested after a witness saw him assaulting and abducting a woman.
On Mother's Day in 2008, Edward Covington unleashed a horrifying attack on his girlfriend and her children.
Convicted sex offender James Randall was responsible for the murders of two women in Florida in the mid-1990s.
When 9-year-old Felecia Williams was reported to have run away, the police were immediately suspicious.
In 1995, mother and daughter Marcia and Elizabeth Honsch went missing.
In 2012, Diane Staudte murdered her husband and son in addition to attempting to kill one of her daughters.
In January 2009, Lakhvir Singh poisoned her former lover, Lakhvinder Cheema and his fiancee Gurjeet.
In 2011, hotel receptionist Attila Ban turned from co-worker to killer when he was alone with his colleagues.
In July 1979, 22-year-old Sally Ann McGrath vanished in Peterborough. Her body was found months later.
In 1985, George Naylor strangled Deborah Kershaw, just weeks after being freed from prison for rape.
A look at the recent deadly outburst of school violence in America, with special focus on Mitchell Johnson and Andrew Golden, two youngsters who killed four classmates and a teacher in 1998.
Story of the former high-school wrestling star who spent eight years as a fugitive in Europe before surrendering in Switzerland in 1995.
The story of the murder of Bobby Kent, a seemingly popular student and ideal son who was lured to a remote area by seven of his friends and murdered.
A case study in how the double jeopardy law sometimes helps criminals escape punishment. Melvin Ignatow was acquitted of the brutal murder of his girlfriend.

The shocking story of a Texan, reported to be worth $500-million, who murdered two people and hired a hitman to kill the judge in his divorce case, but used his wealth to win acquittals in both cases.
Story of high-profile Atlanta lawyer Fred Tokars, who hired a gunman to murder his wife in front of their two young children.

A gun-wielding man car-jacks and sexually assaults two young women before one of them flees naked down the road. A tornado sweeps through a man's home, dragging a sixteen wheel truck through his living room.
A woman is brutally attacked in her home by a man with a knife; and a man spends sixteen days trapped in his car after crashing into a ravine.
After marrying Cristobal Palacio, Jennifer soon discovers his manic need to psychologically abuse her.
Michael Dally and Sherri Guess are a perfect match, but an affair sends the couple down a dark path.
When bad boy Ed meets single mom Jackie, sparks fly until he turns into a family man.
Amanda and Tonch Weldon's swinging lifestyle works well for years until a love triangle takes a deadly turn.
After Tammy Ellis and charismatic loner David Gatlin's quickie marriage, David's dark history is revealed.
When the financial fraud of Shari and Dwight Tobyne is revealed, their marriage turns into a web of deception.
